text.tspan: The slot wall, flattened: a 0.4 mm chamfer along three edges of one tangent chain
rail of edge 1 on the wall
main's chord: from edge 1 to the end of its rail
The band of chamfer 1 on the wall ends at the section it shares with chamfer 2. The band of chamfer 2 starts there,
beside the end of edge 1, and runs to V2. Main judged the sample on rail 3 by chamfer 1's whole edge and refused the chamfer.
The band check now ends each band at its section and judges chamfer 2's band against the whole chain of edges.
